english: Unless you defeat me,\nyou cannot stop\nBotekurikokasu!
Before we got here,\nold Hiraga gave me this.\nSaid it might help...
Now you mention it...\n'Killing with kindness'?\nThose kinds of Kotodama?
The Kotodama inside...\nDifferent from usual?\n...Compliments?
Perfect.\nThese Kotodama are...\n'Killing with kindness.'
Calling that a bare face\nis a bit misleading...
Gave up being alive.\nWhat's nice about that?
I'll smash your\ncheap revenge along\nwith Botekurikokasu!
Look closely...\nCompliments?\nNo... These are...
Which? No, these\naren't compliments...\nIt's 'killing with kindness.'
Heh. Literally\nkilling with praise.\n...All or nothing.
Take a chance, Yorozuya?
Let's see that ugly face...\n...!!
Given up at last?\nThen I'll tell you\nbefore you die.

Gintoki Sakata...
Half-dead after our fight,
I returned to Harusame HQ. But their leaders
had no place for a loser
like me... Hmph. Tossed out
without a second thought...

Feared as Daraku
of the Harusame...
Reduced to a wretched vagrant. I swore I'd avenge
that humiliation
one day! Another band
of space pirates
was growing in power...

Banbanji valued
my thirst for revenge.
Their technology empowered me. This is my new self!
Mecha Daraku... Heh.
I'll take that as praise.

Say what you will.
With this body and
Banbanji's Botekurikokasu... I'll have my revenge!
Conquer and ravage
the planet you love! Then Harusame is next!
They'll regret discarding
me like a filthy rag! Gwahahaha...
GWAHAHAHAHA!!!!
Beat you and\nthat thing breaks too, right?\n...Saved me some trouble.
Kotodama... No, words...\nUgly on the surface? Insults.\nPretty? Compliments...
Listen up, tin can!\nEven ugly words\naren't always insults.
Even filthy words\nwith heart behind them\ncan be the world's kindest!

Words aren't spoken
with mouths or heard
with ears! [red]Speak and hear with heart[/color]!
That's [red]human language[/color]!!
Shaking! An earthquake?!
See ya!\nDon't get crushed\nbefore you escape!
Gave yourself to machines.\nYou could never beat\na flesh-and-blood human!
No matter how\nfancy the phrasing,\nit means nothing by itself.
Not a quake!\nThe tower is shaking!
No idea! Maybe\nBotekurikokasu's core\nwas part of the tower...!
News to me too!\nThis is bad!\nThe tower won't hold!
...Get back alive.
Mayo's a compliment\nin MY book!
Funny. Was thinking that too.
Why?! Banbanji's science\ngave me a perfect body!\nHow could these vermin...?!

If only my transporter
hadn't been destroyed...
But why...?! Those pathetic
mock-compliment Kotodama...
How did they break it?!
Yeah...\nA fine morning,\njust like always.
A normal Kabukicho morning!
Yeah...\nMixed feelings, though...
Weird mushrooms\nwere washing my brain...
Remember nothing?
Can't even forget it.\nI remember nothing...
Let's meet up with him\nbefore the [blue]New Tower[/color].
No ordinary cans.\f...\fA few days ago,\nI tried to correct\nOedo's spiritual flow...\fWith a special sealing spell.
A large-scale spell\nneeds several charms\nplanted across the area.
It's fine...\fMeant well with the spell.\nBut it had\nunexpected side effects...

Eight charms across Oedo. Disguised as empty cans,
but glowing pale blue.
Easy to spot. Build up speed
and kick them hard!
...If I knew where,\nI'd do it myself.\fMy little sister Mone\nplanted the charms...\fThink SHE remembers where?

Don't forget
to build up speed.
Dash right into them! Once all eight
are kicked away,
come back here.
Oh! Been a while, old man!\fPlaying kick the can again?
No memory\nof when it started...
Now, Shinpachi.\nSore losers look pathetic.

Those cans are the charms?
They ARE unusual... But is it okay
to kick away
your carefully placed charms?
...Got it.\nFind blue glowing cans\nand kick them, right?
Utter defeat...
Ready to die, old man?
Don't even remember hiding...

None of the eight charms
have been dispelled yet. They're scattered far apart.
It'll take a while. When you see
a blue glowing can,
dash into it and kick it!

dash into it and kick it!

All the cans... No,\nall the charms are dispelled.\fThank you...\nWas it hard?
...Maybe so.\fNot much of a reward,\nbut take this\nfor your trouble.
I should go...\nSay hi to the sacred child.

Just kicked them
as we passed by. But good news, right?
The kick-the-can geezer
is finally free?
Sacred child? Oh, Sadaharu...\nDamn! Should've asked\nfor dog-food money...
A letter?\nIf it's a bill,\njust ignore it.
Close! Almost!\fRemember Unkei\nand Kaikei?

A transport ship
carrying their delivery boxes
had an accident. Dropped a few boxes
over Edo, apparently.
And that ship belongs\nto one of idiot Sakamoto's\naffiliated firms.
More trouble, obviously.\nA friend of Gin's, after all.
Trouble, yes! Trouble!
Tiny old guys\npacked into a box.
Luckily, no.\nLooks like it's from Sakamoto.
Idiot! A man's romance\nis about the dream itself!
Tiny old guys!\nPacked in like sardines!
Exactly.\nNo good comes from\na craftsman who talks too much!
So we'll stay\nhere a while.\nNice to meet you!
Phew...\nWhat an ordeal!
Yeah! Still shaking\njust thinking about it!
No, Gin!\nThey're carnivores!\nCan't leave them loose!
An accident, but\nwe're responsible.\nWe have to do something...
Roaches ran\nto that geezer's place?!
Still alive, old man?
The boss!\nOld man, what about it?
Which way'd they go?
South?\nLet's go, Shinpachi! Kagura!

They crawled inside
some weird-looking guy
who happened to be nearby. With him at the front,
they all went off somewhere. Looked like the roaches
were controlling him.
Big duck-looking guy,\na sheet over his head.
Think... Yeah,\ntoward the south...
Big duck,\na sheet over its head...!\nGin!
Passed by just now.\nSeemed rather strange.
Yes, with some\nslimy beetle-like things...\fAlways saying\nchoose your friends wisely...
If you see Elizabeth,\nsay to be home\nbefore dinner.
Zura says\nbe home before dinner!
Useless bum!!
Hey, challenger!\nLook at you!\nTaking part, right?
Hey, challenger!\nYou little rascal!\nTaking part, right?
Showbiz might scout us!
Beginner? Start at Class C.
Class C cleared!\nClass B, for intermediate\nrunners, is available too.
Run on sugar fuel, yes!
Oedo Ironman Race!!\nCLAAASS C!!
A course record?\nLavish prizes await!\nReady?!

to finish! Ready to go?!
That's our natural-perm rep!\nCounting on you!

to finish! Ready to go?!

Class A's long.
REALLY long. Not responsible
if you quit!
Brace yourself, bastard!
A course record?\nLavish prizes await!\nReady?!

[blue]Nabeya St.[/color], Back to [blue]Mayoi Bridge[/color]
to finish! Phew, that was long. Ready to go?!
Disappointing. No guts!
Gin, no dinner\nfor you tonight!
You did it!\nThe lavish prize is yours!
Hmph! Hoped for nothing.
Too bad!!\nNot fast enough!!
What's that? Sour grapes?
Too bad!! Not fast enough!!\fTry again sometime!

HERE IT COMES!
THE FINISH LINE!! That race was practically
a whole vacation!
How'd you do?!
Made it...\nBut... So tired...\nGonna puke...
Gin, take responsibility!\nI'm the protagonist\nfrom now on!
Too bad!!\nNot fast enough!!
Racing now!\nDon't bother me!
Run past my shop.\nThe flowers\nwill soothe your heart.
Oh, in the race?\nWant some water?
Good luck.\nWin a prize,\nthen pay your rent.
Not telling you!\nI'm racing! Don't bother me!
Lavish prizes?\nI'll get one for sure!
Fast times\nwin prizes, right?
Seriously?\nWith that sugar-rotted body?\nNo record for you.
Anything!\nJust move it out of my way!
Kondo, aim for\nthe stairway to heaven.
Quit working so hard\nat stalking all the time!!
Move! Outta my way!!
Thank you for before.\nThanks to you,\nKanshichiro's growing well.
Laugh lots. Cry lots.\nGrow up fast!\fOnly you can\nprotect your mother!
You said...\fCry lots, laugh lots,\nand grow up fast\nto protect me...
The hint...\nSomewhere you\nlaugh and cry a lot...
Gah! Stop! Don't bite!\nI didn't make him cry!
A cinema...\nMaybe wanted to watch a film?
Depends on the movie!\nTragedy, comedy...

Kanshichiro...
Growing up means... Laughing and crying
for yourself,
not imitating others...
There, there. Don't cry!\nWant some Sukonbu?
[blue]Koei Theater[/color]...\nWhy come to a cinema?\nWhat was the plan...?
Naturally,\na cinema shows\nlots of different movies.
That's it!\nA cinema's full\nof laughter and tears!

Gin's words made
Kanshichiro want
to grow up fast... So, to laugh and cry
a whole lot...
You came here, right?!
Grow up fast.\nLaugh and cry for yourself.\nProtect Mom on your own.\fGot it?

Shh! Too loud!
The old [blue]Rengokukan[/color],
to be precise. Some ronin and
the Shinsengumi wrecked it.
Closed for a while.
Keep it quiet,\nbut they hold\nunderground Gin Tama battles.
Illegal Gin Tama\nwith huge bets.\nSerious money changing hands.
We destroyed [blue]Rengokukan[/color]\nin the Kidomaru case...\nNever thought it'd return...
Qualifications?\nI've got a moped license.

Confident, huh...
Can't just say
'Sure, come right in.' Entering old [blue]Rengokukan[/color],
as fighter or spectator,
requires qualifications.
Heh. Gutsy.\nOn guts alone,\nyou'd already qualify.

Quit the stock
parting threats. Get lost. ...
What's happening
in [blue]Rengokukan[/color] this time...?
Close, but no.\nCan't beat me?\nNo right to a pass.
Right...\nNot today.\nMust be low on sugar.
Sugar? What?\n...Whatever.\fBest not take\nneedless risks, huh.
Hey, sounds like\nit's inside this house.\n...Take a look?
Grown adults.\nHow embarrassing.
Quiet! Settle down!
What?!\nThat was practically fraud!
Leave us alone!\nHis dirty tricks\nare the problem!
Kindergarteners, are you?!
What?! YOU'RE\nthe dirty cheater!
Not so much a legend...\nMore a curse\nor ghost story...
Shouldn't disturb them.\nLet's go.
Calling you Master\nfrom now on!
...The legendary\ncarpenter Mokichi!
Ugh...\nMaster Mokichi...
Thanks to you.
Booming business is nice,\nbut you look swamped...
Help each other\nin a pinch!\nLet's lend a hand.
